name: Lafete
description: Lafete was an Outer Rim Territories planet that included factories and the Port of Lafete city on its surface. There, the Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and his associate Boba Fett met with the Mandalorian Nite Owls Bo-Katan Kryze and Koska Reeves to negotiate a rescue plan of Djarin's foundling, Grogu.
